upstream_source.description: The surviving source retains the classic public routines, selection helpers, word-break hooks and Macintosh Plus history. The reconstruction keeps matching operands and comments and restores the uniform-font implementation from the ROM.

boundary_evidence.description: The reference symbols place TEGetText at $41608E after the Dialog Manager and InfoScrap at $416DAC. DefClikProc ends with a short branch at $416DAA. The source contains the same classic routine set, with later styled-text routines interspersed. ScrapMgr spans $416DAC through $416F90; PackageMgr follows.

restored_internal_names.description: These descriptive names identify restored branches and helpers whose exact original labels are unavailable. Some correspond to later local labels. SetLineArray and CharByChar have additional support in the original history.

history_support.SetLineArray: The June 1986 history names SetLineArray among the modified routines. The earlier helper at $4169E8 grows the line array.
history_support.CharByChar: The June 1985 history names CharbyChar and its corrected BLE comparison. The ROM retains that loop at $41691E.
history_support.Preflight: The May 1985 history describes the preflight routine and its callers. Its original label is absent from the surviving code.

changes.description: Retained the original copyright header and complete history from July 1983 through November 1985. Excluded later history and contracts that require styled text, script dispatch, character buffering or outline selection.

Restored the 104-byte record and uniform line-height calculation. TENew allocates a cleared record, copies the destination and view rectangles, obtains font metrics and saves the current port font and mode. Removed later style and dispatch handles.

Restored the twelve-byte standard frame, argument-size entry variants and allocation preflight. StdEntry and StdExit save and restore handle flag bytes directly. They preserve the port and clipping region without the later font and color save areas.
Retained the original fast TextBox path and restored its allocation check. Strings without carriage returns use TextWidth and DrawText when they fit. Other strings use a temporary TextEdit record.

Restored the sixteen-byte frame containing rLine and rTrue. DoDraw, DoSearch, DoCaret and DoHilite use one font and line height. RangeRect measures both selection boundaries, expands complete line edges and updates teSelRect. TrimMeasure removes trailing break characters before TextWidth.
Retained FindWord, FindLine and TrimMeasure dispatch hooks and the original default word-break procedure. Restored the word-width scan, carriage-return handling and character fallback in FindLine.

Restored the earlier ReCalLines algorithm, which updates line starts in place and grows the TextEdit handle with eight spare bytes. Its stack saves for D2 and D4 provide the returned redraw boundaries. The later separate insert and delete algorithms are absent.
Restored the original Copy, Cut, Delete, Paste, Insert and Key paths with Munger. TEKey handles backspace and passes other characters to PasteGuts; later cursor-key and text-buffer paths are absent.
Restored uniform-height scrolling and the old autoview bit in teFlags. DefClikProc expands the view rectangle by eight pixels horizontally and half a line vertically, then calls TEPinScroll directly.

Retained the original lo16 EQU *+2 declaration before the AND.L immediate in DefWordBrk. Five PC-relative operands read that instruction operand as a mask. The shared translator now handles the current-location expression without changing the source declaration.

Included only the required original interface equates and named trap opcodes. Restored frame declarations use symbolic field offsets. Explicit branch sizes and PC modes retain the ROM encodings. No instruction is represented by a raw data declaration.

preserved_rom_behavior.description: CalText retains the delta $8002. The later source uses $8001 and explains that value as a correction for an insertion length of 32,767 into empty text.

DoSearch retains the original MOVE.W D3,D4 before loading the line start into D3. It clears D4 before copying D3 into its low word. The January 1986 history records a later correction to this register conversion.

PasteGuts uses the incoming D7 value for its allocation check before calculating the selection length. The January 1986 history explicitly moves SelSort and the selection-length calculation before this check. That fix is absent from the ROM.
A zero scroll returns after TEScroll has hidden the caret. The later source instead branches to ActCaret. The ROM TEPinScroll path separately calls ShowCaret after Scroll.

The negative vertical and horizontal adjustments add the calculated offset. Later source changes these operations to subtraction, including a December 1988 note for the horizontal bug. Both original additions remain.
The ROM uses the November 1985 WordRedraw branches. It lacks the later additional WordRedraw test under DrawWholeLine.

limitations: The exact 1985 source file is unavailable. The surviving source and its dated history support the restored structure; the ROM establishes every instruction and encoding.
The internal names listed above are descriptive where no original label survives. They do not claim recovery of the exact original spelling.
The byte comparison and symbol checks do not execute text drawing, mouse tracking or allocation-failure paths.

verification.method: Translated the final MPW source, assembled for the 68000, linked at $41608E, rejected unresolved relocations and compared every byte with the ROM. Checked all recorded labels, including the scoped lo16 constant inside DefWordBrk.
verification.ghidra_note: The reference exports seventy traps as one-byte unsupported instructions. Named trap declarations and the ROM establish their complete two-byte encodings. The other 1,114 reference records match the decoded instruction bytes.

prose_lint.scope: Authored source comments and evidence prose. Preserved original comments were excluded.
